quote: “Yes, of course it hurts when buds are breaking. Why else would the springtime falter?”
source: Karin Boye, Yes, Of Course It Hurts, lines 1 and 2, För trädets skull (1935) (trans. David McDuff, 1994)

evidence.where: The Karin Boye Society site (karinboye.se), which hosts McDuff's Complete Poems translations and files this poem under For the Tree's Sake, 1935; Bloodaxe and Wikipedia entries for Complete Poems (Bloodaxe Books, 1994)
evidence.edition: Karin Boye: Complete Poems, trans. David McDuff (Bloodaxe Books, 1994)
evidence.locator: Yes, Of Course It Hurts, lines 1 to 2

reason: McDuff's opening two lines read exactly as proposed and the poem belongs to För trädets skull (1935) as the proposal says. Wikipedia files it under Härdarna, but the Boye Society index places it in the 1935 book. Not shipped, not at cap, not banned.
